description: This file defines a lightweight UI model class 'ContinueWatchingItem' used for the 'Continue watching' feature in the front end of a streaming platform. It imports a content model dependency and contains a class with two required properties.

classes.name: ContinueWatchingItem
classes.description: A UI model representing an item in the 'Continue watching' interface with content information and viewing position.

methods.name: ContinueWatchingItem
methods.description: Constructor for initializing a 'ContinueWatchingItem' with required 'content' and 'positionSeconds' properties.
